title: Research file front matter
description: Front matter contract for docs/research/*.md, per the T12 research contract (archive/sessions/2026-09-02-t12-research-contract-plan.md). Checked by scripts/check-research.mjs.

topic.description: Stable kebab-slug. One topic may have many files over time (current + superseded + historical).

supersedes.description: File names (docs/research/*.md) this file replaces. Reciprocal with the target's superseded_by.

superseded_by.description: File name (docs/research/*.md) that replaced this one. Required when status is superseded.

sources.description: URLs or repo paths this file's findings are grounded in. At least one.

decisions.description: DEC ids this file changed or informed.
